include.description: Sections: player, deck, relics, potions, combat, screen (default=all). 'map' must be explicitly requested.

name: get_game_state
description: Get game state. Sections: player, deck, relics, potions, combat, screen (default=all). 'map' excluded by default (large/static) - request explicitly when needed.

name: get_map
description: Get the full visible act map with room coordinates, directed paths, current position, and 1-indexed next route choices. Use before choosing a path.

name: get_piles
description: Get visible combat pile contents. Draw-pile cards are unordered because their exact draw order is hidden in the game.

include_cards.description: Include every card in each character's catalog, not just locked cards

include_achievements.description: Include achievement names and unlock states

name: get_profile_progress
description: Read the active profile's character statistics, unlock progression, locked cards/relics, and optional full card and achievement catalogs. Works from the menu or during a run.

operation_id.description: ID returned by a still-running action

name: get_action_status
description: Get the final result of an action that outlasted the request wait. Never replay the action just because its response was pending.

name: get_screen_state
description: RECOMMENDED: Get current screen state (screen_type, choices, hand, monsters, buttons). Use this instead of get_game_state for routine checks.

name: get_available_commands
description: Get available tools for current screen with descriptions. Returns screen_type and available_tools list.

name: get_card_info
description: Get detailed card info (description, stats, upgraded version). Use when you need to know what a card does.

relic_ids.description: Relic IDs to query (e.g., ["Burning Blood", "Vajra", "Snecko Eye"])

name: get_relic_info
description: Get detailed relic info (description, tier, flavor text). Use when you need to know what a relic does.

actions.description: Array of action objects. Each object has 'action' field plus action-specific params. Available actions: play_card(card_index OR card_name OR card_id, target_index?), end_turn, choose(choice_index - 1-indexed position in choices list), proceed, skip, cancel, confirm, select_cards(drop:[cards] OR keep:[cards] - specify cards by index/name/id, auto-confirms), use_potion(potion_slot, target_index?), discard_potion(potion_slot), wait(ms? - default 100ms, max 500ms).

drop.description: Cards by initial hand index, name, or ID

card_index.description: 1-indexed card position in the initial hand

keep.description: Cards by initial hand index, name, or ID

name: execute_actions
description: Execute actions in sequence, waiting for each to settle and returning per-action before/after state. Stops when the screen or enemy intent changes so you can reassess. INDICES ARE STABLE - use positions at call time, don't recalculate! Examples: (1) Play cards by name: [{action:'play_card',card_name:'Bash',target_index:1},{action:'play_card',card_name:'Strike',target_index:1}]. (2) Play by index (stable): Hand [1:Strike,2:Defend,3:Bash] -> play 1 and 3: [{action:'play_card',card_index:1,target_index:1},{action:'play_card',card_index:3,target_index:1}]. (3) Collect rewards: [{action:'choose',choice_index:1},{action:'choose',choice_index:2},{action:'proceed'}]. (4) Survivor discard: [{action:'play_card',card_name:'Survivor'},{action:'select_cards',drop:['Strike']}]. (5) Gambler's Chip keep best: [{action:'select_cards',keep:['Bash','Inflame']}].

target_index.description: 1-indexed monster position (required for targeted cards like Strike)

card_index.description: 1-indexed position in hand (mutually exclusive with card_name/card_id)

card_name.description: Card display name, e.g., 'Strike', 'Strike+' (mutually exclusive with card_index/card_id)

card_id.description: Card internal ID, e.g., 'Strike_R', 'Defend_G' (mutually exclusive with card_index/card_name)

name: play_card
description: Play a card from hand. Specify card by ONE of: card_index, card_name, or card_id. Add target_index for attack cards. Examples: {card_name:'Bash',target_index:1}, {card_index:3,target_index:1}, {card_name:'Defend'}. Prefer execute_actions for playing multiple cards.

name: end_turn
description: End turn. Prefer execute_actions to combine with card plays.

name: choose
description: Select an option from the current screen's choices list by index. Use get_screen_state to see available choices first. Prefer execute_actions for multiple sequential choices.

target_index.description: 1-indexed monster position (required for targeted potions like Fire Potion)

name: use_potion
description: Use a potion from your potion slots. Targeted potions (e.g., Fire Potion) require target_index.

name: discard_potion
description: Discard a potion to free up a slot for a new potion reward.

name: proceed
description: Click the proceed/continue button to leave current screen. Available on: COMBAT_REWARD (after collecting), REST (after resting), SHOP_ROOM, CHEST, COMPLETE screens.

name: confirm
description: Confirm current selection. Available on: GRID (card selection), HAND_SELECT (discard/exhaust selection) screens.

name: skip
description: Skip without selecting. Available on: CARD_REWARD (skip card pick), BOSS_REWARD (skip boss relic) screens.

name: cancel
description: Go back or cancel current action. Available on: SHOP_SCREEN (leave shop), MAP (close map), GRID (cancel selection) screens.

name: start_game
description: Start a new run with the specified character. Only available from main menu (not in dungeon).

name: continue_game
description: Continue a previously saved run. Only available from main menu when a save file exists.

name: abandon_run
description: Abandon the current run and delete the save file. Only available from main menu when a save file exists.

name: save_game
description: Exit the current run to the main menu. Continue restores the game's latest autosave checkpoint; choices in the current room may need to be repeated.
